name: Mosul
scopeLimits: The WUP locator is a settlement centroid, not a parcel identity. Official Ministry sources confirm a Nineveh/Mosul-area registration directorate, but public deed/map e-services are limited to selected Baghdad directorates and require owner documentation. The official reconstruction GIS is project/facility mapping, not a cadastre. No anonymous city parcel layer or parcel geometry was found; no private data or credentials were used.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The Iraqi Ministry of Justice lists the Nineveh Real Estate Registration Directorate (including al-Zuhoor) as a local property-registration office. The Ministry’s electronic deed/map services are described as rolled out in selected Baghdad directorates, and the official service workflow requires owner documents; this does not establish a public parcel-map service for Mosul.
